title: PR tool relocation and global discoverability

completion_criteria.text: MSP-1: models learn the centralized PR tool BEFORE hitting the gate - CLAUDE.md bullet plus a globally-visible self-triggering pr skill
MSP-2: PR tool relocated out of the mitosis lib to a neutral path, gate selfwrap updated atomically, no shim at the old path
Both MSPs shipped as stacked PRs, each independently correct, CI green, merged
Close the CRITICAL gate bypass by structurally rewriting block-destructive-bash.sh to parse-then-decide-per-command against the 12 invariants; regex patching cannot reach INV-3 or INV-4
Fix the boundary-regex false-positive and its twin false-negative uniformly across BOTH deny branches, inside the c4 rewrite; the merge branch stays unexempted per decision 0246
Close the deployed-copy premise as falsified, and document the real gap instead: new TOP-LEVEL files under .claude/hooks or .claude/rules stay dark until the Stow installer reruns
Fix basename-keying in no-self-merge-consent.test.mjs by pairing prefix and dir as the sibling scanners do

spine.active_goal: PR tool relocation shipped. The gate work is redesigned and has moved to its own thread; what remains here is CI and verification debt on PRs #39 and #40.
spine.next_step: The gate redesign continues on the CHILD thread (gate-redesign-per-action-decomposition), NOT here - resume that one. Its pickup document is handoff-2026-08-05-bash-gate-redesign/artifacts/RESEARCH-AND-PLAN.md, outside the repo. Residual work on THIS thread is only the CI and verification debt in the risks below: the missing invariant-coverage artifact that fails every PR from this branch, and the threatened M3/M4 verdicts on PR #39.
spine.last_session: Researched the gate design from scratch, ratified a scoped assurance level and a per-action decomposition, then archived the rejected rewrite and restored HEAD's regex gate as the live guard.

open_risks.text: Never delete or prune branch archive/gate-parser-rewrite-2026-08-05 — commit 21ae349 is the ONLY copy of the 1663-line rewrite, it was never pushed, and it holds the INV-4 structural fix, realpath identity work and expanded tests worth mining

The revert reopened wrapper-plus-newline laundering — HEAD's gate has that hole and the archived rewrite had closed it; this is the accepted cost of decision 0250 and only the decomposition closes it for good

The gate fails OPEN on its own bugs — only exit code 2 blocks, so a crash, a timeout or malformed output all let the command run; the rebuild must force a blocking verdict on any internal fault rather than trusting the platform
An empty verdict with exit 0 is read as allow — a silently-swallowed exception is indistinguishable from the gate having no opinion; make no-opinion an explicit token in the rebuild
The boundary false-positive is live and was hit first-hand this session — a command merely CONTAINING the text of a denied action is denied, so normal work will trip it until the decomposition lands

Do not answer a new finding with another fix round — six rounds each closed one finding and opened another; check every finding against the written goals and non-goals first, and close a non-goal finding as accepted risk

The worst holes predate this branch — attached -f body=@path exfiltration, /graphql endpoints, git checkout of the hook and perl -pi of the hook are open on HEAD and main alike, and the revert changed none of them

Add the missing invariant-coverage artifact before any PR from this branch — CI fails every pull request that adds no file under the coverage directory, and each file needs a verdict row for all twelve registry ids

The approved permissions.allow narrowing still does not achieve what it was for — these are prefix rules, so node --test admits any path, node .claude/ admits traversal, every rule admits an arbitrary suffix, and git checkout of the hook stays ungated

Stage only the permissions.allow hunk from settings.json — that file also carries unrelated user edits to model, effortLevel and plugin entries that must not be swept in; the hunk applies cleanly on its own
Do not attribute the one npm test failure to this work — it reproduces on pristine main and is caused by the home settings.json no longer resolving out of the home tree

Confirm the threatened M3 and M4 verdicts on PR #39 or schedule the missing tests — nothing asserts that the CLAUDE.md pull-request bullet or the pr skill file exists, so a regression in that guidance would be silent in CI

key_decisions.title: Relocate the PR tool to .claude/lib/git/pr.mjs with no shim at the old path
Teach the PR tool through a global skill and a CLAUDE.md bullet, keeping the gate as backstop
Rewrite the bash gate to parse-then-decide-per-command rather than patch its regexes
Leave the merge deny branch without a selfwrap exemption
Close the deployed-lib-copies follow-up as false and document the Stow unfolding gap instead
The bash gate is a defense-in-depth control at a scoped assurance level, not a security boundary
Abandon general bash parsing; decompose the five protections into five per-action controls
Archive the rejected rewrite and restore HEAD's regex gate as the live guard

out_of_scope: A Windows-path PreToolUse hook that fails on darwin in a separate private repo - surfaced from the original error output, enforcing nothing there, never in scope for this thread
Renaming .claude/lib/superpowers-parallel itself - the directory name is still a fossil, but only the PR tool needed to leave it
The ~/.claude/settings.json symlink drift behind the protect-claude-config failure - it belongs to the permission-config-audit thread, and changing live settings is the user's call
Stale ground truth in the 2026-07-29 install-pin-safeguards spec (records 10 depth-1 entries, live is 9; ~/.claude/state now exists) - that spec is unimplemented and on another thread
